text:
samira_infra: quick heads-up
We saw a surge in preview token estimates for a small set of embedding tenants after enabling adaptive sampling. Preview ~= 1.9x final.

devon_sre: alerted by the preview healthcard. traces show sample_weight being applied in both the router and again in the preview aggregator for some request paths. also seeing retries with new request_id values (old SDK behaviour).

harry_billing: ledger dedupe currently keys on request_id. if retries create new ids, we double-count sampled requests. short options: (1) require SDKs to set x-client-retry-of on retry, (2) fallback to server-side fingerprint.

annie_prod: SDK change is slow for some customers. fingerprint fallback sounds pragmatic, but product wants transparency: console must show "est." badge + provenance.

samira_infra: fingerprint idea: sha1(tenant_id || '|' || model || '|' || trunc(prompt_sha256,16)). store it as fingerprint on raw events. use COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) as dedupe_key in aggregators.

devon_sre: perf caveat: hashing full prompts on the hot path is expensive. proposal: compute fingerprint synchronously only when tokens >= 1000 OR tenant flag metering_fingerprint_sync=true. otherwise write event with dedupe_basis=pending and run async enrichment pipeline to fill fingerprint later.

harry_billing: ledger can accept a dedupe_basis string (request_id | retry_header | fingerprint | pending). we'll require aggregator to emit it so invoice rows can show provenance.

annie_prod: console UX: add a provenance column and a confidence pill: high(request_id), medium(retry_header), low(fingerprint), pending(async). hover explains implications and links to billing docs.

samira_infra: aggregator change: make sampling a single responsibility at the aggregator. router will only tag sample_rate; aggregator applies sample_weight once. simplifies reason-about and avoids double-apply race.

devon_sre: canary plan: pick three tenants (small/med/large), 2% traffic for 30m -> 10% for 2h -> 50%. metric: metering.preview_to_final_ratio{route="embeddings"}. abort if >1.25 for 15m.

harry_billing: SQL sketch (pseudo):
WITH raw AS ( SELECT *, COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) AS dedupe_key FROM raw_metering WHERE ingest_day = current_date ) SELECT tenant_id, dedupe_key, SUM(tokens) * (1.0 / NULLIF(sample_rate,1.0)) AS est_tokens FROM raw GROUP BY tenant_id, dedupe_key;

samira_infra: add NULLIF to avoid div-by-zero when sample_rate == 1.0 (no sampling). good catch.

devon_sre: runbook shorthand: 1) abort if metric breaches, 2) flip shim to passthrough sample_rate and disable fingerprint fallback, 3) run backfill async to correct previews, 4) notify billing + product.

annie_prod: small ask: add a debug header x-metering-debug=true that causes shim to echo dedupe_basis into raw events for canary tenants. helpful for quick verification.

harry_billing: we'll run a parallel ledger ingest for canary tenants and diff preview vs final. will post results after first 2 hours.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary/metering-shim v3.0 -> staging (owner: samira_infra) :rocket:

devon_sre: thanks
I'll own dashboards and alerting during canary. samira, harry: can you both add short acceptance checks to the RFC so ops can verify provenance shows up end-to-end?

samira_infra: will add checks and a sample payload to RFC. linking here when ready. :thumbsup:
